# Invented watch criteria

What the invented feed keeps. Written as tests,
not as topics.

## Sources

| Source | Sender | Cadence |
|---|---|---|
| Invented Gazette | `gazette@example.com` | daily |
| Invented Letters | `letters@example.com`, **free** | weekly |

- Invented Gazette
- Invented Letters, **weekly**

## An item survives if

1. It changes how the **garden** is planted.
2. It names a `trail` opening nearby.
